about_the_game:
Argue, Argue, Argue!!!

The world's first AI-powered legal sim has arrived. Make arguments, convince the jury, win your case — and more. You'll discover secrets hidden deep in the world of Beagll Town. Meet new and interesting characters. And discover and interact with the world in ways you didn't think we're possible.

Step into the paws of Harold Beagll, golden retriever attorney at law. Legal Beagll: Justice is Argued is a story-driven legal RPG powered by AI-driven characters that argue back, fight your claims, and challenge your position.

🐾 What Is This Game?

Part visual novel, part JRPG, part legal simulation. You’ll argue cases, cross-examine witnesses, and spar with prosecutors in intense “logic duels.” The battle system of a traditional turn-based games is revamped. You'll fight with your words, and the only one deciding the victor will be the judge and jury. 

🎮 How Do You Play?

  • Investigate Cases: Talk to suspicious dogs, track down shady chew toy companies, and sniff out clues.

  • Argue in Court: Use your arsenal of legal maneuvers to counter testimony, expose contradictions, and persuade the jury.

  • Face GPT-Powered Opponents: Every witness, client, and prosecutor is more than just dialogue trees. They’ll argue back with wit, logic, and personality, forcing you to think on your feet.

  • Manage Status & Strategy: Court battles use a turn-based system where arguments can exhaust your opponent, inspire the jury, or leave you tongue-tied if you’re careless.

  • Survive the Weirdness: Life is stranger than fiction, but Beagll Town is stranger still. Be careful, these dogs bite back.

Do you have what it takes? Can your logic pull your case through? Or are you all bark and no bite?

Whether you’re here for the comedy of talking dogs in suits, the thrill of courtroom sparring, or the chaos of GPT-powered opponents pulling moves you didn’t see coming, Legal Beagll: Justice is Argued is ready to make its case.

Objection? Overruled.

short_description: Legal Beagll: Justice is Argued is a courtroom simulation RPG where every trial is a battle of wits. You’ll take on the role of Harold Beagll, a golden retriever attorney navigating a legal system filled with sharp-tongued rivals, eccentric clients, and unpredictable witnesses.
